selection_reason: Small fixed convenience subset expanding the Week 1 records, with MLII and N/V examples. No record or parameter selection based on model scores. This is not the full standard inter-patient benchmark.

class_meaning.V: Premature ventricular contraction (original annotation symbol only)

excluded: All symbols other than N and V are excluded as targets; no AAMI superclasses are claimed. The first beat, incomplete windows and nonfinite or constant windows are excluded.
features: Previous reference beat interval (seconds), raw window standard deviation and peak-to-peak amplitude, plus 24 interpolated values from a per-window z-normalized 216-sample segment.
preprocessing: No filtering, imputation, oversampling or record-level fitted normalization. StandardScaler is fit to training features only in both learned-model pipelines.
metrics: Fixed-label macro-F1, accuracy, balanced accuracy and per-class precision, recall, F1 and support; confusion matrices and per-record macro-F1.
tuning: None. One fixed train/evaluation partition, one Random Forest seed, no validation search.
scope: Offline oracle-annotation-centered beat classification, not automatic beat detection, live monitoring or clinical validation.
subject_policy: The six selected records represent different subjects according to the database documentation. Records 201 and 202 share a subject and are excluded; the subject-group function also groups them together defensively.
